title: Rivet 3: Figma to code token guide
readMe: Figma is the source of truth. Every token has ONE name, used the same in Figma and in code.
Code name rule: --rvt- + the Figma name with every '/' turned into '-'. Example: Figma text/default → --rvt-text-default. Figma Dev Mode shows these exact names.
'codeToday' is the name in rivet-source now (null = doesn't exist yet). 'action' says what to do: none, rename, add, value change, remove.
Naming can still be adjusted: see 'namingSuggestions'. Suggest a name and it changes in Figma first, so both sides stay identical.
Colors are hex; sizes are px; when desktop and mobile differ both are listed.

namingSuggestions.how: Want a different name? Download rename-suggestions.json from the guide, add one entry per token, and send it to Jenn. She applies it in Figma (renaming keeps every component connected), the guide regenerates, and code uses the new name. Don't rename only in code.

toDo: 1. Add generated/rivet-tokens.css (download from this guide) after the current token CSS. It defines every token with its Figma name: palette, all three themes, mobile values, text-style shorthands, shadows, and aliases for the old names so nothing breaks.
2. Make the changes in 'componentChanges' (6 visual changes, plus badge token names and the CTA hover icon token, which don't change the look).
3. Replace old names with new ones using 'migration' (search and replace; old names keep working through the aliases until you're done).
4. Apply the value changes marked 'value change' (text styles, font weight 700, font width 110%, shadows, mobile spacing).
5. Delete the deprecated aliases and the code-only tokens Jenn approves removing ('codeOnly').
After that, Figma and code match 1:1. New tokens start in Figma; name suggestions go through 'namingSuggestions'.

textStyles.note: Each Figma text style becomes one --rvt-font-* shorthand (font: weight size/line-height family, plus width). 'rename' = same values as today's code token; 'rename + value change' = closest code token, valueChanges lists what moves to Figma's spec; 'add' = no code token yet.

weights.name: font/weight/700
weights.note: Replaces --rvt-font-weight-black (750) everywhere it is used: Figma headings and display text are 700.

families.name: font/family/sans
families.note: Code keeps its full fallback font stack; Figma only stores the first font.

families.name: font/family/mono
families.note: Code keeps its full fallback font stack; Figma only stores the first font.

widths.name: font/width/semi-expanded
widths.note: Use 110% (Figma's value) instead of the keyword 'semi-expanded' (112.5%).

spacing.note: Named by px. From 32px up, values are smaller on mobile.

migration.note: Old rivet-source name → new name. Search and replace; the generated CSS keeps old names as aliases until you finish.

themeColors.note: Each old theme property splits into role-specific names. Pick by what the CSS property does.

codeOnly.note: Tokens that exist only in code today. For a true 1:1 sync each needs a home in Figma or should be removed. Recommendation below; Jenn decides.

items.recommendation: Remove after migration. Older color ramps; nothing in Figma uses them.
Remove. Figma uses px tracking per text style (font/tracking/*).

items.tokens: --rvt-size-* (the raw dimension scale, e.g. --rvt-size-48 for heights)
items.recommendation: Add to Figma as a size scale so component dimensions use shared names.
Add to Figma as layout tokens (no visual change) so they share names.

figmaRenameHistory.note: Old Figma names → current Figma names. Only useful if you see an old name in an older spec or screenshot. Code names didn't change.
